title: Cultish: The Language of Fanaticism
author: Amanda Montell
summary: Amanda Montell looks at how language draws people into cults, from Jonestown and Heaven's Gate to fitness brands and multilevel marketing, and how similar tactics show up in everyday life.
readIf: you like pop-linguistics with a conversational, wry voice and an interest in group persuasion.
skipIf: you want a rigorous academic study of cult psychology.
